body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Spectrometer Data Processing Engine, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Wavelength and radiometric calibration). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Wavelength and radiometric calibration and Baseline, smoothing, and normalization. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Spectroscopy data interpretation software) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
